title: The Man Who Sold Air
summary: A scoundrel set up a toll gate on the mountain path, demanding a copper coin from travelers for breathing the pure mountain air....
full_text:
A scoundrel set up a toll gate on the mountain path, demanding a copper coin from travelers for breathing the pure mountain air.

Nasruddin approached, took a deep breath, puffed out his cheeks, and held his breath for three minutes while walking through the gate.

On the other side, he exhaled loudly: "I took my breath on the plain below; I haven't inhaled a single particle of your mountain air! Good day, toll-keeper!"
moral: Greed that attempts to monetize what God created free earns empty pockets.
